paper.title_en: Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and derive the condition under which the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy. We show that the two entropies coincide when a specific condition involving the extrinsic curvature of the brane is satisfied. In particular, this condition is automatically satisfied for static configurations. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding conditions for the equality between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that they take the same form as that obtained for Einstein gravity. Although the equality is not guaranteed for general stationary configurations, the required condition is satisfied for static braneworld black holes, leading to an agreement between the two entropies. These results clarify the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.

decision.title_zh: DGP膜引力中的黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在引力动力学局域于膜上的膜世界引力中，引力熵与全息纠缠熵之间的关系。我们首先考虑DGP膜模型，其中在膜作用量中包含了Einstein-Hilbert项，并推导出膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致的条件。我们表明，当涉及膜的外曲率的特定条件得到满足时，这两个熵重合。特别地，该条件对于静态构型自动满足。然后，我们将膜局域的Einstein-Hilbert项推广到更高曲率引力理论。对于膜上的Lovelock引力和$f(R)$引力，我们推导出引力熵与全息纠缠熵之间相等性的相应条件，并表明它们与Einstein引力所得条件形式相同。尽管对于一般的稳态构型，这种相等性并不保证，但对于静态膜世界黑洞，所需条件得到满足，导致两个熵之间的一致。这些结果阐明了膜世界引力中引力熵与全息纠缠熵之间的关系，并有助于更深入地理解膜世界设定中的全息原理。
